parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false** (default)

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Anti-DDoS instance. The value is fixed to **cn-hangzhou**, which indicates the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: A list of IDs of the Anti-DDoS instances from which you want to remove tags.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The value is fixed to **INSTANCE**, which indicates an Anti-DDoS instance.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: A list of tag keys to remove.
